declarations.docstring: An auxiliary relation on objects indexed by two partitions.
Two auxiliary objects related in both directions are equal.
The displayed subgroup membership and permutation relation imply the auxiliary relation between the two objects.
Every auxiliary object is related to itself.
The partial order induced by the auxiliary relation.
The displayed relation between permutations yields pointwise inequalities between their auxiliary counts.
Nonvanishing of every diagonal auxiliary coordinate implies linear independence of the displayed family.
A nonzero auxiliary coordinate evaluation implies the corresponding order relation.
